a.lede: A newly disclosed OpenSSH vulnerability dubbed "*sshole" allows attackers to log in to certain Alpine Linux and other musl-based Linux accounts that are configured to block password authentication, simply by entering an oversized password. [...]
a.title: OpenSSH flaw lets attackers log into password-disabled Linux accounts

b.lede: SonicWall has released security updates to fix seven vulnerabilities in SonicOS firewalls, including an SSL-VPN authentication bypass flaw exploited in attacks. [...]
b.title: SonicWall warns of new SSL-VPN MFA bypass flaw exploited in attacks
